claims.object_mention: modulation of neuronal firing patterns and excitability
claims.quote: It is caused by de novo genetic variants in KCNT1 that alter the function of Slack, an evolutionarily conserved sodium-gated potassium channel that modulates neuronal firing patterns and excitability.
Pathogenic KCNT1 variants lead to overactive Slack channels, boosting total neuronal potassium currents by up to 40%, driving cortical hyperexcitability and causing seizures.
